description: Library tool extensions in 024-mcp-agent-ux: keyword search for list_library, tags and snippet in get_library_entry_info, tags persistence in set_library_metadata.

query.description: Optional keyword filter. Case-insensitive substring match against entry name, description, and tags. If omitted, all entries are returned.

snippet.description: Full snippet of the tagged function's body

tags.description: Tags associated with this library entry
Tags to associate with this library entry. Replaces existing tags.
